---
title: Future q.bt integration
---

::: {.callout-important}
The API on this page is planned, not implemented. Today, use Lean CLI directly as described in the other guides.
:::

`q.bt` is intended to support two independent execution backends:

1. a future in-process QRT event kernel shared with `q.gym`;
2. an optional adapter that orchestrates the standalone Lean CLI.

The LEAN adapter should not reimplement LEAN's event engine or hide its native artifacts.

## Proposed responsibilities

A typed QRT API should be able to:

- identify a LEAN workspace and algorithm file;
- select a pinned engine image and data root;
- validate parameters and custom-market registration requirements;
- launch, monitor, cancel, and reproduce local backtests;
- parse result JSON, logs, order events, charts, and data-request reports;
- expose original artifact paths alongside QRT-normalized summaries;
- prepare and generate HTML/PDF reports;
- record command, image, parameters, environment, and artifact hashes.

A possible user-facing shape is:

```python
import qrt as q

run = q.bt.lean.backtest(
    workspace=".temp/leansweden",
    algorithm="demo_sma.py",
    parameters={
        "backtest-start": "2024-01-02",
        "backtest-end": "2024-12-30",
    },
    update_image=False,
)

result = run.wait()
report = result.report(destination="sma-report.html")
```

This sketch is not yet a compatibility promise.

## Ownership boundaries

The adapter should own orchestration and normalization, while LEAN continues to own:

- event progression and subscriptions;
- order, fill, fee, buying-power, and portfolio accounting;
- native market-data and universe formats;
- result JSON and Report Creator behavior.

QRT should preserve raw LEAN artifacts even when it creates derived result objects. A report compatibility transform must write a copy and never mutate the original result.

## Reproducibility record

Every adapter run should retain at least:

```text
workspace path
algorithm source path and hash
LEAN CLI version
Docker image tag and digest
lean.json/config.json hashes
parameters
data root identity
start/end timestamps
result and log paths
exit status
```

## Roadmap

Track implementation on the [q.bt roadmap](../bt/roadmap.qmd). The standalone tutorials remain valid after an adapter lands because the API will invoke the same underlying commands and consume the same artifacts.
